[HIGH] handlers.py:2 — SQL injection via f-string interpolation
Impact: user_id flows directly into the query string, letting an attacker alter the query's structure and read or modify data outside the intended row.
Fix: use a parameterized query, e.g. db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,)).
